content:
The test image shows a very young soybean seedling at the soil line with the seed/cotyledon still visible, one cotyledon shriveled and decaying, soft rot at the hypocotyl, and soil sticking to the tissue — classic signs of pre/post-emergence damping off.

The Pythium_damping_off reference collage is a near-perfect match: identical presentation of green cotyledons with decayed/collapsed hypocotyl tissue at the soil level, soil adhering to rotted tissue, and the same growth stage.
